calls.title: xAI<>GrowthBook - Discussion
calls.summary: The call focused on xAI's need to synchronize GrowthBook feature flags from their commercial instance to a self-hosted Azure GovCloud environment without public internet access, while maintaining a single source of truth and controlling visibility. Key participants included Samuel Nathanson and Gurshan Ghumman (xAI), along with GrowthBook's Jake Heier, Chris Sanders, and CTO Jeremy (Growthbook Dorn).
